description: Image understanding: describe, count, and read text from bundled test images. Needs a vision model.
name: Vision

tasks.prompt: How many red circles are in this image? Answer with just the number.
How many blue squares are in this image? Answer with just the number.
What number is written on the sign in this image? Answer with just the number.
Describe the shapes in this image in one sentence.
What does the sign say? Answer with just the text on the sign.
